messages:
deploybot: PROD deploy STARTED — tag v3.6.0, commit a1b2c3d. Region: prod-usw2. Change window: 2025-06-15T19:00Z-21:00Z. Rollout plan: canary 5% -> 50% -> 100%. Pinned by @olivia. Link: https://deployments.redwood.internal/rollouts/1742000000

olivia: Ack. I'll watch latency and memory dashboards, will call hold if anything odd.

jin: Noted — smoke looks good, but I'm seeing a small uptick in KV cache evictions on the canary (p95 +120ms) at 5% traffic.

sam: Can we pause at 5% until we validate the spike? don't want to push to more users if it's systemic.

olivia: Good catch. pausing rollout. @deploybot please hold rollout and notify oncall.

deploybot: ROLLOUT PAUSED at 5% (canary). Reason: manual hold by @olivia. Notifying oncall and posting observability snapshot.

ops-bot: @oncall (pager): Investigate canary KV evictions spike — link to metrics: https://metrics.redwood.internal/canary/1742000000

maria: I pushed an autoscaler tweak to reduce aggressive cache eviction under burst; new candidate commit b4c5d6e ready to test.

olivia: Nice. Can we swap canary to b4c5d6e and rerun the 5% check?

deploybot: Canary image switched to commit b4c5d6e. Rolling canary at 5% again.

jin: Rechecking telemetry — eviction rate back to baseline within 2 minutes of swap, p95 latency normalized.

sam: Looks clean from infra side. +1 to resume.

olivia: Resuming rollout to 50%. Keep an eye on traces for any error class regressions.

deploybot: Rollout progressing: 50% -> 100% in automated steps.

jin: Telemetry stable across regions, no error spikes.

maria: Confirmed autoscaler metric shape improved.

deploybot: PROD deploy COMPLETE — final commit b4c5d6e (tag v3.6.0+fix). Cutover recorded at 1742000400. Pinned by @olivia.

olivia: Thanks team. I'll add a short note to release notes: "v3.6.0: inference runtime updates + autoscaler fix; canary had transient cache evictions resolved by commit b4c5d6e."

sam: :shipit:

deploybot: Closing rollout thread. If you need to rollback, use `/deploy rollback --tag v3.6.0` or ping #incidents.
